name: Mamoswine
description: This species reached its zenith during the period known as the ice age. I suspect that Hisui's frigid climate is in harmony with Mamoswine's constitution, thus awakening hidden potential.

moves.name: Tackle
moves.description: A physical attack in which the user charges and slams into the target with its whole body.

moves.name: Ice Shard
moves.description: The user flash-freezes chunks of ice and hurls them at the target. This also raises the user's action speed.

moves.name: Bulldoze
moves.description: The user tramples its target into the ground, dealing damage. This also lowers the target’s action speed.

moves.name: Icicle Crash
moves.description: The user attacks by harshly dropping large icicles onto the target.

moves.name: High Horsepower
moves.description: The user fiercely attacks the target using its entire body.

moves.name: Ancient Power
moves.description: The user attacks with a primeval power. This may also raise the user's offensive and defensive stats.

moves.name: Blizzard
moves.description: A howling blizzard is summoned to strike the target. This may also leave the target with frostbite.

moves.name: Double-Edge
moves.description: A reckless, life-risking tackle in which the user rushes the target. This also damages the user.
